card.name: Phone call and connection contexts
card.fires_on: Words in text about phone calls, call setup and ending connections, just before a word like call, contact or terminating is expected. Examples are the 'and' before 'terminating' sessions, 'area' before 'code', and a comma before 'please contact'.
